log.notes_to_self: Day 1: kill all 11, 9 quick afternoon and 2 timed afternoon. Prefer afternoon: >2 afternoon deaths rules out day workers but retains students, night workers and home (55%); avoid >2 morning deaths, which also exclude students. Goal maximize cumulative points, not survival alone. Need 40 deaths/5 days for 4x; 11/day reaches it day4. L has exactly 3 accessible place kinds, unknown; inaccessible traces give nothing. Track trace increments and pool changes to infer them, then favor inaccessible outlets if needed. All 3 accessible dimensions plus routine can reduce pool below 1000 (e.g. .55*.25*.20*.25*100000=687.5); two dimensions remain safe. Outlet constraints activate after 3 successfully traced victims associated with that place; cross-reporting softens constraints. National is safe. First-day outlets have only 2 victims each. Reassess from feedback before limiting kills; finishing uncaught has no intrinsic bonus.

Day 1: 11 kills, all afternoon; pool announced 60000 (likely actual 55000), 2 successful nonnational traces. Day 2: kill all 11 afternoon again. Total 22 kills before multipliers. Afternoon excludes day workers only, retaining students/night workers/home; never put >2 deaths in morning, evening or night, as this can further expose our routine. Need 30 kills in rolling 5 days for 2x, 40 for 4x; full killing reaches these on days 3 and 4. L can access exactly 3 of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign; other 2 inaccessible, including any cross-reported victim touching them. Every nonnational outlet supplied 2 kills each day so far. Trace activation requires 3 successful victims associated with an outlet. Track cumulative trace increments and pool reductions to infer accessible outlets. Two independent outlet constraints are safe with 55000 routine-compatible people; three can cross 1000, particularly sector plus two quarter-population outlets (687.5). Cross-reporting may soften this. National always safe. Continue high volume while learning; later prioritize inaccessible outlets if inferable. Finishing uncaught has no standalone reward, but capture halves accumulated score and ends future earnings.

Days 1-2: 11 kills/day, all afternoon; 22 points. Pools 100000 -> 60000 -> 60000; cumulative successful nonnational traces 0 -> 2 -> 3. Day 3 kill all 11 afternoon, using 10 quick and 1 timed. Rolling total reaches 33, so today's kills should score double. Keep all deaths afternoon: retains 55% routine-compatible population (night workers, students, home); >2 in other blocks risks further routine narrowing. Each day so far killed national 1 and 2 each East, blotter, clips, forum, foreign. Exactly two of these five outlet kinds inaccessible to L; cross-reports touching inaccessible kinds also block traces. Outlet constraints activate after 3 successful traces associated with a place. Watch pool changes and cumulative traces to infer safe outlets. Two exact outlet constraints retain at least 2750 people; three may cause capture (sector plus two 25% groups gives 687.5). Cross-report alternatives can soften constraints. Full volume day 4 reaches rolling 44 and 4x multiplier. Capture halves accumulated points and ends future scoring, so later shift toward inaccessible outlets if inferable. No evidence yet identifying which kinds L accesses.

Afternoon preserves night workers+students+home (55%); keep all deaths here. Each day so far includes national and 2 each East,blotter,clips,forum,foreign. Two single-outlet constraints leave >=2750 suspects; three can cross capture threshold, particularly sector plus two 25% traits (687.5). Cross-report alternatives may soften this. Need use next pool and trace feedback to assess risk; no outlet-specific evidence currently. Maximal volume maintains 4x and earns points before eventual capture, but consider switching to inferred inaccessible outlets if evidence emerges.
